neighbours.label: Broad, weak pole on function words (a, an, are, the, it) where the next word is likely an importance/relevance word (important, central, essential, concerned, related, regarding); roughly the opposite of the + pole's 'different/change' predictor. Mixed and diffuse, not a single token.
fire: When the budget is tight, having an emergency fund becomes an essential part of any household plan.
The committee reviewed the evidence and agreed that early screening plays a central role in reducing mortality.
Many of the villagers living along the river are directly concerned with the new flood regulations.
In most clinical trials, patient consent is a key requirement, and it is regarded as vital by regulators.

For a small bakery, location turns out to be a critical factor in whether customers keep coming back.
The report notes that water quality in the northern lakes remains a matter closely related to local farming.

Prices at the two stores vary widely, and the final total may shift depending on the exchange rate.

notes: 10x pilot (concept-maps/tenx, random arm): label and 16 sentences written by a fresh Sonnet 5.5 subagent from a packet (card + all-pole band samples); no probes. An Opus gate checked rule-level items only (8 + 8, 0 overlap with census and probe text, near misses free of the declared trigger) and edited nothing. Labeller's note: Strong activations land on assorted function words (a, an, are, the) and a few content tokens; 2.3% of tokens reach 0.1 of max, and output tokens promote important/central/concerned/related, so I labelled it as a position predicting an importance/relevance word; expect it to be weak and diffuse.
